about_the_game:
Scary Together is a 4-player co-op horror game. Explore terrifying levels filled with jump scares, solve puzzles, and experience the thrill of being scared together. Perfect for players who love screaming—and laughing—with friends.

🎮 Genre: Horror Co-op Experience
Scary Together is a terrifying multiplayer horror game designed for up to 4 players. Work as a team, or panic together, as you face your worst fears in the dark.

👥 4-Player Co-op
Survive together in a group of four. Cooperation is key—but fear can break even the strongest teams.

💀 Jumpscares Galore
Expect the unexpected. Scary Together is packed with intense jumpscares that will catch you (and your friends) off guard.

🔓 Level-Based Progression
Each level presents unique challenges, puzzles, and horrors. Clear each stage to uncover deeper layers of the nightmare.

😂 Fun Through Fear
Screams turn into laughter as you watch your friends freak out. In Scary Together, being scared has never been this fun.
